;Installation.

;For replacement of license plates simply replace a file vehicle.txd in a folder models/generic in the catalogue with game 
;
;For installation use IMG Tool 2.0. This program lays on any site
;about GTA in section of "tools". Having opened her(it) gta3.img (is in a folder models in the catalogue with game)
;replace files savanna.dff, savanna.txd, exh_lr_sv1.dff, fbmp_lr_sv1.dff and rbmp_lr_sv1.dff  replace command or press Ctrl+R, on files from archive.
;further we open "Notebook" a file vehicles.ide (a folder data), we find and we replace a trace. A line:

567, 	savanna, 	savanna, 	car, 		SAVANNA, 	SAVANNA, 	null,	normal,		7, 	0,	2ff0,		-1, 0.77, 0.77,		2

;further by the above mentioned program ("Notebook") it is opened handling.cfg and we find and we replace a trace. A line:

SAVANNA      1500.0    2500.0   2.0    0.0 -0.15 0.1 125 0.75 0.84 0.53     4 160.0 24.0 5.0  R P   8.17  0.52 0 35.0   0.3  0.10  0.0  -0.10 -0.22 0.30 0.25       0.3  0.52 19000     40202000    02010004    2  2    0

;following number in our program installation of colors it in a file carcols.dat:

savanna, 93,44, 44,36, 123,92, 109,100, 101,101, 95,105, 83,110, 66,25
